Ashok Kumar Arunachalam

GenAI Architect | Enterprise Solution Architect | AI/ML & Backend Systems Expert

ashokstalone@gmail.com.com 

+91 9597224438

Chennai, India	 linkedin.com/in/ashok-arunachalam

GenAI Solution Architect with 10 years of experience in designing enterprise-grade AI/ML and agentic AI solutions. Skilled in architecting multi-agent systems, integrating LLMs with legacy and cloud-native platforms, and enabling secure, scalable workflows. Strong foundation in backend development, microservices, and API ecosystems, with expertise in RAG architectures, data analytics, and cloud platforms (Azure, AWS).

SKILLS

GenAI Frameworks

Langchain,Langgraph,CrewAI,Microsoft Copilot

Programming Languages

Python, JavaScript, SQL, PHP

Version Control & Cloud

GIT, AWS, Azure, Azure Cognitive Services	Backend

Frameworks

Laravel,FastAPI,Flask

Computer vision	OpenCV,Pytorch,YOLO	Cloud Services	AWS,AZURE,GCP and Digitalocean

Vector Databases	Pincecone,Qdrant,FAISS	Messaging Queues

Kafka,RabbitMQ,AWS SQS,AWS SNS

Operating Systems

Linux (Debian ), Windows,MAC OS	Databases	MySQL, MSSQL,Mongo and Postgres

WORK EXPERIENCE

	Associate Manager - Platform Solutions

Sutherland Global Services

09/2022 - Present	Chennai

Achievements/Tasks

Architected multi-agent AI solutions for diverse enterprise domains including claims management, insurance underwriting, and travel support agent assistance , reducing manual errors and cutting processing time by 30–40%.

Designed invoice extraction and PO matching system using LangGraph-based agents , achieving 95%+ accuracy in document processing and reducing manual intervention by 60% .

Delivered a KYC automation project leveraging multimodal LLM instruction , improving compliance checks and risk assessment efficiency, while reducing onboarding turnaround time by 35% .

Led AI-powered POCs that demonstrated agentic workflows across multiple verticals (insurance, travel, BFSI), influencing client adoption and unlocking USD 500K+ in revenue growth .

Implemented scalable microservices and asynchronous processing to handle high-volume document workflows, reducing average response times by 40% .

Collaborated with pre-sales and solutioning teams to present AI architectures, respond to RFPs, and customize solutions , accelerating deal closures and client onboarding.



WORK EXPERIENCE

Assistant Manager - Digitalization

Larsen & Toubro

05/2019 - 09/2022	Chennai, India

Achievements/Tasks

Partnered with cross-functional teams and vendors to deliver data-driven digitalization initiatives across safety, workforce, and operational efficiency domains.

Designed and deployed a machine learning–based incident prediction model on HSE datasets, enabling proactive safety interventions and reducing downtime by 25% .

Built a demand forecasting system for scaffolding resources using time-series analysis and regression models, optimizing workforce allocation and cutting project delays by 20% .

Developed an anomaly detection framework for workforce attendance tracking , identifying irregularities and improving compliance monitoring by 30% .

Engineered a predictive maintenance solution for plant and machinery, reducing unplanned downtime and extending asset lifecycle.

Automated data pipelines and built analytics dashboards in Python, R, and Power BI, empowering leadership with real-time insights for project health, productivity, and cost tracking.

Sr. Engineer - Technical Records

Flydocs India - Lufthansa Technik AG

09/2015 - 04/2019	Vadodara, India

Aviation End of Lease & Asset Management Software Achievements/Tasks

Automated aircraft records classification using OCR techniques , improving data extraction accuracy and reducing manual

processing efforts.

Implemented data pipelines to automate aircraft maintenance reporting, integrating data from various sources for faster, more reliable operational insights.

Developed BI dashboards using data visualization tools such as Power BI, providing real-time tracking of aircraft operations and supporting data-driven decision-making.

Awarded Employee of the Year (2017) for spearheading automation initiatives that significantly improved operational efficiency and reporting accuracy.

EDUCATION

M.Tech DataScience and Engineeing

Birla Institute of Technology and Science,Pilani

09/2019 - 08/2022	Chennai, India

B.E Aeronautical Engineering

Jeppiaar Engineering College, Anna University

08/2011 - 04/2015	Chennai, India

LANGUAGES
